summary: Kootenai NF lookout site in Lincoln County, Montana; a 1930s cabin and crow's nest; marked abandoned by firelookout.com and gone on the FFLA list. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com marks it abandoned and the FFLA list marks the site gone; neither gives a date

events.note: Firelookout.com gives only the decade, 1930s, for a cabin and a crow's nest about two miles east; no build date is given for the lookout itself
Firelookout.com marks the lookout Abandoned; no date given
The FFLA list marks the site Gone; no date or cause given

evidence.supports: Kootenai National Forest is the agency
1930s cabin and crow's nest about two miles east; page asks if still there; marked abandoned
evidence.quote: 1930s: cabin, crows nest 2 miles east (still there?). Abandoned.

evidence.supports: lookout structures and sites list, Lincoln County

notes_for_editor: Two terse sources only. Firelookout.com (Rex Kamstra) gives the agency, county, elevation, location, the 1930s decade and the word Abandoned; the FFLA list gives coordinates, type Ground and status Gone. The story reports both status words without choosing between them. No Forest Lookouts (montanalookouts.weebly.com) page for this name is in the index, and no firetower.org (FFLOS) page was found at the URLs tried. Searches returned no other Montana source. Brief record checks out: Lincoln County, coordinates match the FFLA list, ground kind matches. Nothing on staffing, fires, access or the site today. A Kootenai NF history or local newspaper source would be needed for a fuller story.
